dict.長さと上りは、まっすぐの線で測っためやすです。歩く道は、町の地図や現地で選んでく: Length and climb are rough estimates measured along a straight line. Please choose your walking route using the town map or on site. It is also a good idea to check the route for nighttime and rainy days once while it is still light.
dict.距離はまっすぐ測ったもので、坂や道の曲がりは考えていません。歩く時間は1分60m: Distances are measured in a straight line and do not take slopes or road bends into account. Walking time is estimated at 60 m per minute (the walking speed of older adults), and slopes are estimated from the ups and downs along the straight line (they differ from the actual slopes of the roads). Elevation above sea level is read from GSI tiles (elevation tiles), and flood depth is a rough estimate read from the colors of the projection map. Please follow the town's guidance when deciding whether to evacuate.
